text: The Art of Design is a Netflix original documentary series that showcases artists in the field of design. It premiered on Netflix on February 10, 2017. The series was created by Scott Dadich, who was formerly the editor-in-chief of Wired. The first season featured interviews with illustrator Christoph Niemann, Nike shoe designer Tinker Hatfield, stage designer Es Devlin, architect Bjarke Ingels, automotive designer Ralph Gilles, graphic designer Paula Scher, photographer Platon, and interior designer Ilse Crawford. In 2019, Netflix announced a renewal for a second season, which was released on September 25, 2019.
